code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(out),len(out[0])
    for color, dr, dc in [(9,1,-1),(2,1,1)]:
        pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==color]
        if len(pts)>=2:
            a,b=pts[0],pts[1]
            # Extend the established diagonal direction through its points.
            if b[0]!=a[0]:
                dr=1 if b[0]>a[0] else -1
                dc=1 if (b[1]-a[1])*(b[0]-a[0])>0 else -1
                r,c=pts[-1]
                while 0<=r+dr<h and 0<=c+dc<w:
                    r+=dr;c+=dc;out[r][c]=color
    return out
'''
open(os.path.join(base,'task-926b338c.py'),'w').write(code)
